splash_skip.note: A small line under the studio's logo on the opening splash. Tells the player that pressing any key or tapping the screen goes straight on to the game.

credits_title.note: Heading of the credits panel: the list of the people who made the game.

credits_close.note: The X button on the credits panel. Closes it and goes back. Same word as Close elsewhere in the game.

credits_opens.note: Read aloud by screen readers for a name in the credits that links to a web page. {name} is the person or group; keep it a plain sentence a person could say.

credits_refused.note: Shown under the credits when a link could not be opened, for example the browser or the platform said no. Short and calm; nothing is broken.
